kebab_example: aliyun ccc redial-call --instance-id abc --user-id samzhang@abc --device-id CCC-x.x.x.x-chrome102-bsdf911812c60f61e --caller 01098100000 --callee 13188880000 --timeout-seconds 30 --tags a=b --job-id job-65815360847220000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
